get.summary: The repository's workflow runs, newest first
get.description: 404 unless the repository has Actions on. Each filter narrows the list; an event or status no run can have lists nothing.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Runs for this branch (without `refs/heads/`).

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Runs started by this event: `push`, `pull_request`, `workflow_dispatch` or `schedule` (other events start no runs).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Runs with this GitHub status or conclusion. `queued` (also `requested`, `pending`) covers runs waiting for a runner or for other runs; `waiting` (also `action_required`) runs awaiting approval; `completed` every finished run. `neutral`, `stale` and `timed_out` are accepted and match nothing. Anything else is a 422.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Runs caused by this user (login).

200.description: One page of runs; `total_count` counts every matching run

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

get.summary: A workflow run

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

get.summary: The jobs of a run (its latest attempt), in the workflow's order

200.description: One page of jobs; `total_count` counts every job of the run

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

post.summary: Cancel a run (write scope and write access)
post.description: Jobs not yet running are cancelled at once; running jobs stop when their runner next reports.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

post.summary: Run every job of a finished run again (write scope and write access)
post.description: The run keeps its number and gets a new attempt. A run of an untrusted pull request waits for approval again unless its author would not wait today.

409.description: The run has not finished, or is a workflow error without jobs

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

post.summary: Run the failed and cancelled jobs of a finished run again, with the jobs that need them (write scope and write access)
post.description: As `…/rerun`, for the failed and cancelled jobs only.

409.description: The run has not finished, has no failed job, or is a workflow error

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The run's id (`id` of a run, not its `run_number`).

post.summary: Approve a pull request run that waits for approval (write scope and write access)
post.description: The run starts, still with a read-only token and without secrets or variables. Approvals are audited.

409.description: The run does not wait for approval

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job's id.

get.summary: A job with the steps of its current attempt

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job's id.

post.summary: Run one job of a finished run again, with the jobs that need it (write scope and write access)

get.summary: The workflows that have runs, by path
get.description: A workflow's `id` is its file name, which `…/workflows/{workflow_id}/dispatches` takes; its `name` is that of its newest run.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's file name (`ci.yml`), or its path (`.forgejo/workflows/ci.yml`).

post.summary: Run a workflow that has `on: workflow_dispatch` (write scope and write access)
post.description: The workflow is read at `ref`, a branch or tag of the repository itself (never a pull request head or a commit id); `inputs` are checked against the workflow's `inputs`. 404 unless the repository has Actions on.

get.summary: The repository's Actions secrets, names only (admin scope; a repository administrator)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name; case-insensitive (names are stored upper-cased).

get.summary: An Actions secret without its value (admin scope; a repository administrator)

put.summary: Create or replace an Actions secret (admin scope; a repository administrator)
put.description: rbit takes the secret's plain `value` over TLS and seals it on the server (AES-256-GCM with a key outside the database); unlike GitHub there is no libsodium sealed box, so `encrypted_value`, `key_id` and `…/secrets/public-key` do not exist, and a body with `encrypted_value` but no `value` is refused. Values are never returned. A repository secret is visible to its repository only.

204.description: The secret has a new value

delete.summary: Delete an Actions secret (admin scope; a repository administrator)
delete.description: Works without the secrets key, so secrets sealed with a lost key can be removed.

get.summary: The repository's Actions variables (admin scope; a repository administrator)

post.summary: Create an Actions variable (admin scope; a repository administrator)
post.description: Runs see it as `vars.<NAME>`; an account's variables are visible to all its repositories (only `visibility: all` is accepted).

409.description: A variable with this name already exists

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name; case-insensitive (names are stored upper-cased).

get.summary: An Actions variable (admin scope; a repository administrator)

patch.summary: Change an Actions variable's value (admin scope; a repository administrator)
patch.description: Unlike GitHub, a variable cannot be renamed: a `name` other than its own is a 422.

delete.summary: Delete an Actions variable (admin scope; a repository administrator)

parameters.name: name

get.summary: An Actions secret without its value (admin scope; an organization owner)

put.summary: Create or replace an Actions secret (admin scope; an organization owner)
put.description: rbit takes the secret's plain `value` over TLS and seals it on the server (AES-256-GCM with a key outside the database); unlike GitHub there is no libsodium sealed box, so `encrypted_value`, `key_id` and `…/secrets/public-key` do not exist, and a body with `encrypted_value` but no `value` is refused. Values are never returned. An account's secret is visible to every repository of the account (`visibility: all`, the default) or to `selected_repository_ids` (`visibility: selected`; only the account's own repositories are kept). Without `visibility`, an existing secret keeps its own.
